PASSKEY_FLOW_EXPIRED: Passkey session expired, please try again
PASSKEY_CREDENTIAL_NOT_FOUND: Passkey not recognized, please use another login method
PASSKEY_POSSIBLE_CLONE: Passkey security check failed, please use another login method
PASSKEY_ALREADY_REGISTERED: This device already has a passkey
PASSKEY_LAST_LOGIN_METHOD: Cannot remove your only login method, please add another first
LAST_LOGIN_METHOD: Cannot remove your only login method, please add another first
BAD_REQUEST: Invalid request — please check and retry
MISSING_HEADER: Missing required headers — please update the app
INVALID_INSTALLATION_ID: Device not recognized — restart the app
INSTALLATION_NOT_FOUND: Device not registered — restart the app
WECHAT_PHONE_FETCH_FAILED: Couldn't get your WeChat phone number
ALREADY_REGISTERED: Account already registered — sign in instead
INTERNAL_USER_LOGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: Use the staff portal to sign in
TOPIC_NOT_EXPLICIT: Push topic must be specified explicitly
RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many requests — please slow down
CAPTCHA_REQUIRED: Too many attempts — please complete the verification to continue
RISK_CONTROL_COOLDOWN: Too many attempts — please try again in 5 minutes
CONFLICT: That value is already in use — please use a different one
CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: This was just changed by someone else — reload and try again
NOT_IMPLEMENTED: This feature is not available yet
VALIDATION_MIN: Value is below the minimum allowed
VALIDATION_ONEOF: Value is not one of the allowed options
UPSTREAM_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later
STAFF_CODE_CONFLICT: Staff code already linked to another account
TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED: Please select a company to continue
NO_TENANT_BOUND: Account is not linked to any company — contact your administrator
TENANT_NOT_AUTHORIZED: You don't have access to this company
TENANT_DISABLED: Your membership in this company has been disabled — contact your administrator
TENANT_INACTIVE: This company / supplier is inactive or not approved — contact the platform administrator
MENU_NOT_GRANTED: Selected permissions are outside the granted menus
ROLE_NOT_AVAILABLE: Role is not available for this company
ROLE_NOT_DELEGABLE: Role is outside your assignable scope
ROLE_IN_USE: Role is still assigned to members — unassign it first
ADMIN_TRANSFER_REQUIRED: Transfer the administrator role before this operation
ADMIN_ROLE_REQUIRED: The administrator must be granted at least one management role
CALLER_NOT_ADMIN: Your account has no administrator role for this operation
SUPER_ADMIN_REQUIRED: Only the platform super administrator can do this
SUPER_ADMIN_EXCLUSIVE: The platform super administrator cannot hold tenant roles or company/supplier access
ROLE_OWNER_REQUIRED: Select the company or supplier this role belongs to
ROLE_OWNER_NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot create or edit roles for this company or supplier
ROLE_PARENT_INVALID: The parent role must be an administrator role you hold
ROLE_HAS_CHILDREN: This role still has child roles — remove them first
MENU_HAS_CHILDREN: This menu still has child menus — remove them first
ROLE_GRANTS_EXCEED_PARENT: Selected menus or permissions exceed the parent administrator role
ROLE_CODE_RESERVED: Role code "admin" is reserved for the platform
ROLE_CODE_EXISTS: Role code already exists, please choose another
ROLE_CATEGORY_INVALID: Pick a valid role category: platform, supplier or company
ROLE_CATEGORY_MISMATCH: This role's category does not match the tenant — suppliers take supplier roles, companies take platform or company roles
ROLE_NOT_GLOBAL_ASSIGNABLE: A tenant's own role cannot be granted on the whole-dimension scope (all companies / all suppliers) — pick a built-in role, or grant the specific companies or suppliers instead
